usedFor: Facebook Messenger gets page messages and Google Contacts keeps the address book, so “New Page Message” can run “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Page Message” in Facebook Messenger, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each new message from a person lands as a saved contact, so people who wrote in are not lost.

watchOut: “New Page Message” fires on every message, so “Create Contact” can run again when the same person writes twice.
